purpose: Investigate the existing zero-inclusion result, then compare a larger input on the same pitch-class cohort. No new labels, final-test scoring, real accuracy or model promotion.

stage_1.task: Memorization diagnostic on the first 12 existing training rows; same images reused for trainer validation and standalone scoring. This is not held-out performance.
stage_1.initialization: Same pinned COCO weights; no resume or warm-start
stage_1.selection: Score last.pt rather than a selected best checkpoint
stage_1.target_size_statistics: Training split only; no validation or test image inspection
stage_1.next_stage_gate: Run the predeclared grouped 512 comparison if either memorization fit produces at least one same-class inclusion mask match at IoU >= 0.5 and confidence >= 0.25 on its selected training images. Otherwise retain the failure and investigate supervision before another broad fit.

stage_2.task: Full grouped fit at 512, compared with the existing fullmask 256 run on the same 44 validation images and five development clips
stage_2.selection: Trainer best checkpoint, same selection procedure as historical baseline; independently score common native masks
stage_2.performance: Report seed/secondary/inclusion TP, FP and FN, seed area/overlap, all family results, negative/deadline coverage and CPU latency. More computation at 512 is explicitly allowed and reported, not treated as a fixed-compute comparison.

limits: Upsampling 256-pixel RGB adds no captured detail. It changes network/mask sampling and compute. Memorization cannot prove generalization, and synthetic validation cannot prove real KDP performance. No confidence sweep or label modification after results. All failures retained; existing final test families stay unscored.
